description.summary: A Semantic Retriever retrieves candidates using semantic representations such as embeddings.
description.description: A Semantic Retriever is a RAG component that retrieves candidate documents or chunks by comparing semantic representations, such as embeddings, for a query and indexed content.

responsibilities: Retrieve candidate records using semantic representations such as embeddings.

inputs.name: Query
inputs.description: The search query represented or transformed for semantic matching.

outputs.name: Candidate ranking
outputs.description: A ranked candidate list produced by semantic matching.
